test_title: SSC CGL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On : 7 March 2023)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is not a LibreOffice Software Suite program?
solution:
LibreOffice is a free and open-source office suite, consisting of several applications for word processing, spreadsheets, presentations, graphics, and databases.

__
 
• **The correct option is 2) LibreOffice Excel, as Excel is a proprietary spreadsheet application developed by Microsoft and not a part of the LibreOffice suite.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• LibreOffice Writer: A word processing application similar to Microsoft Word, used for creating and editing documents, letters, and other text-based files.
 
• LibreOffice Calc: A spreadsheet application similar to Microsoft Excel, used for organizing, analyzing, and presenting data in a tabular format.
 
• LibreOffice Impress: A presentation application similar to Microsoft PowerPoint, used for creating and delivering multimedia presentations with text, graphics, and animations.
